skill.name: video-edit
skill.description: Route video edits to Wan, Kling, or Lucy on RunComfy, with model-specific prompts for background changes, packaging swaps, motion transfer, and restyling.

content.user_title: Edit Videos with Intent-Based RunComfy Routing
content.value_statement: Video edits require different models for restyling, motion transfer, and localized changes. This skill selects a RunComfy route and supplies model-specific prompts and settings.
actual_capabilities: Select Wan, Kling, or Lucy based on the requested video edit.
Prepare Wan background and packaging edits with preservation goals and optional reference images.
Prepare Kling motion transfer using a reference video, target image, and orientation setting.
Prepare Lucy outfit and lighting changes with identity-preservation prompts.
Set supported audio preservation, resolution, and duration options for the selected model.
Invoke the RunComfy CLI with model-specific inputs and a selected output directory.
limitations: Requires a RunComfy account, authenticated CLI, network access, and accessible source-media URLs; processing occurs remotely.
Wan accepts 2-10 second MP4 or MOV clips up to 100 MB, with a 1080p output ceiling.
Kling caps output at 10 seconds in image orientation or 30 seconds in video orientation.
Lucy is limited to 720p without aspect-ratio control; each call uses one model, and preservation results are not guaranteed.

use_cases.title: Refresh Presenter Backgrounds
use_cases.description: Use Wan to change a presenter background while requesting preservation of face, pose, lip movement, and source audio.

use_cases.title: Preview Packaging Changes
use_cases.description: Use Wan with a packaging reference image to request a new design while preserving the original framing and hand movement.

use_cases.title: Transfer Character Motion
use_cases.description: Use Kling to apply motion from a reference clip to a target character image with an explicit orientation and audio preference.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Change an Outfit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Lucy to change the outfit in [video URL] to professional business attire. Preserve face and motion, and save results in [absolute output directory].
prompt_templates.scenario: A localized outfit change without motion transfer.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Replace a Background
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Wan to replace the background in [video URL] with a modern office. Preserve face, pose, lip movement, and original audio. Save to [absolute output directory].
prompt_templates.scenario: A talking-head background edit using a compatible short clip.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Apply a Packaging Reference
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Wan to replace packaging in [video URL] using [reference image URL]. Preserve framing, hand movement, and audio. Save to [absolute output directory].

prompt_templates.title: Expert: Transfer Reference Motion
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Kling to transfer motion from [reference video URL] to [target character image URL]. Set image orientation, preserve reference audio, and describe motion as [motion description]. Save to [absolute output directory].
prompt_templates.scenario: An image-oriented motion transfer within the 10-second output limit.

output_examples.input: Replace the background of a six-second presenter clip with a modern office and keep the original audio.
output: Requested change: modern office background with neutral lighting.
Preservation goals: speaker face, pose, and lip movement.
Expected deliverable: an edited clip downloaded after a successful RunComfy job.

output_examples.input: Apply motion from an eight-second dance reference to a target character image and retain the reference sound.
output: Illustrative edit plan: Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control.
Inputs: target character image and motion-reference video.
Orientation: image, with a 10-second output ceiling.
Audio preference: keep original reference sound.
Expected deliverable: a motion-transferred clip for review after successful processing.

best_practices: State preservation goals first and request one edit direction per call.
Check source format, duration, size, and target resolution against the selected route before submitting.
Use authorized media URLs, approve remote processing, protect credentials, and review the output before publication.
anti_patterns: Combining background, outfit, packaging, and motion changes in one request.
Using a restyle route when the primary goal is precise reference-motion transfer.
Submitting confidential media without remote-processing approval or expecting guaranteed identity preservation.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Execution requires access to an authenticated RunComfy CLI.

faq.question: Which model is selected by default?
faq.answer: Wan 2.7 Edit-Video is the default. Kling handles reference-motion transfer, while Lucy handles localized outfit and lighting edits.

faq.question: Does this skill edit videos locally?
faq.answer: No. The local CLI submits requests to RunComfy, where model servers process source-media URLs. Generated results are downloaded to the output directory.

faq.question: Can I preserve the original audio?
faq.answer: Wan supports the origin audio setting. Kling supports keeping original reference sound. The documented Lucy route does not expose an audio preservation option.

faq.question: Can I combine several models in one edit?
faq.answer: No. Each call selects one model. Multi-route blending is outside the documented workflow.

faq.question: Are identity and motion preservation guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. Preservation prompts guide the selected model, but outputs require review. Simplify the request when identity or motion drifts.
